name: slides
description: Headless presentation-deck SDK: author slides in Markdown or HTML, model themes/transitions/fragments/vertical stacks, serialize to JSON, and export a self-contained reveal.js HTML deck. Primary consumer surface is the headless SDK (".") plus a reveal.js React viewer ("./react"). Pure library: no server, no CLI bin, no store.

waivedSurfaces.reason: Headless deck library with no HTTP service boundary.
Headless deck library; MCP execution belongs to consuming applications.
